book.name: Fes Kranakuls
book.title: Fes Kranakuls Ola Stori Blanga King Deibid

content: Ola femili lain blanga Benjamin
Wal Binjaman bin abum faibala san. Olabat neim bin Bela, Eshbel, Eihera, Noha en Refa.
Wal detlot san blanga Bela bin Eda, Gira, Abaihad, Ebishuwa, Neiman, Ahowa, Gira, Shefufan en Huram.

Wal detlot san blanga Ihud bin Neiman, Ahija en Gira. Deibin jidan boswan blanga ol detlot femilimob hubin jidan langa Geba, bat sambodi bin meigim olabat gowei en jidan langa Menahath. Gira det dedi blanga Yusa en Ahihad bin go lida blanga olabat wen deibin go en jidan langa Menahath.

Wal Shaharaiyim bin andimwei im dubala waif Hushim en Beira. Afta na wen imbin jidan langa det kantri gulum Moweb imbin merrit langa Hodesh, en dubala bin abum sebenbala san neim Jobab, Saibiya, Misha, Melkam, Jeyus, Sekiya en Mirama. Ol im san olabat bin jidan bos langa olabat femili.
En imbin abum dubala mowa san blanga im feswan waif gulum Hushim en deibin neim Ebitab en Elpeil.
Elpeil bin abum thribala san gulum Iba, Misham en Shemed. Wal Shemed na bin bildimap det dubala taun gulum Ono en Lod en detlot najalot lilwan taun deya gulijap du.
Ola femili lain blanga Geth en Aijalan

Wal Beraiya en Shema, dubala bin jidan bos blanga ol detlot femili hubin jidan langa det taun gulum Aijalan, en deibin andimwei detlot pipul hubin jidan langa Geth. En detlot san blanga Beraiya bin Ahiyo, Shashak, Jeramath, Sebadaiya, Erad, Ida, Maikul, Ishpa en Joha.
Detlot Benjamin pipul hubin jidan langa Jerusalem
Wal detlot san blanga Elpeil bin Sebadaiya, Meshalam, Hiskai, Hiba, Ishmerai, Islaiya en Jobab.
Wal detlot san blanga Shimiyai bin Jeikim, Sikri, Seibdai, Eliyeinai, Silethai, Eliyel, Adaiya, Beraiya en Shimrath.
Wal detlot san blanga Shashak bin Ishpan, Iba, Eliyel, Ebdan, Sikri, Henan, Henanaiya, Elam, Entathija, Ifdeiya en Penyuwel.
Wal detlot san blanga Jeroham bin Shamsherai, Sheharaiya, Ethalaiya, Jareshaiya, Ilaija en Sikri.
Wal ol dislot na bin ola grengrenfatha boswan blanga ol detlot femili hubin jidan langa Jerusalem.
Detlot Benjamin pipul hubin jidan langa Gibiyan en Jerusalem
Wal Jeiyel bin stadimap det taun gulum Gibiyan en imbin jidan deya. Im waif neim bin Meiyaka.
En im feswan san bin neim Ebdan. En im najalot san bin neim Suya, Kish, Beil, Nera, Neideb,
Gedowa, Ahiyo, Sekaraiya en
Mikloth hubin dedi blanga Shimiya. Ol detlot femili na bin jidan langa Jerusalem gulijap langa detlot najalot femili langa olabat ronwan klen.
Det femili blanga King Sol
Wal Nera bin det dedi blanga Kish, en Kish bin det dedi blanga King Sol. Sol bin abum fobala san neim Jonathan, Melkishuwa, Abinadeb en Eshbeil.
Jonathan bin det dedi blanga Meribeil en imbin det dedi blanga Maika.

Wal Maika bin abum fobala san neim Pithon, Melekai, Tareiya en Eihes. Eihes bin det dedi blanga Jehoyada, en imbin det dedi blanga thribala san neim Elamath, Esmabeth en Simri. Simri bin det dedi blanga Mosa, en Mosa bin det dedi blanga Biniya, en Biniya bin det dedi blanga Refa, en Refa bin det dedi blanga Eliyeisa, Eliyeisa bin det dedi blanga Esel.
Wal Esel bin abum siksbala san neim Esrikam, Bokeru, Ishmeil, Shiyaraiya, Obadaiya en Henan.
Det braja blanga Esel gulum Eshek bin abum thribala san neim Yulam, Jeyus en Elifalet.
Ol detlot san blanga Yulam bin jidan brabli gudwan solja, en deibin yusum olabat bo en erro gudwei du. Imbin abum 150 san en grensan. Ol dislot na bin brom det Benjamin klen.
